en:
## New Features

- Narrator auto-pruning is now opt-in. A new global default (off by default) controls whether new narrators enable pruning, and the toggle is available in both the narrator panel and agent settings. Note that enabling it may invalidate prompt caching and increase billing.

## Bug Fixes

- Auto-normalize URL protocols in settings inputs (gateway STT base URL, Cline callback URL), with IPv6 support and Windows path detection so paths are left untouched.
- Render backslash-delimited LaTeX math (`\(...\)` / `\[...\]`) correctly by converting it to dollar syntax, while leaving code blocks and inline code untouched.
- Bound the NUG image cache with content-addressed dedup and an LRU ref set, so base64 images in long chat histories are no longer re-sent in full on every turn.
- Prevent reusing stale compacted context by tracking pending history compaction, avoiding compacting the same context twice.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 叙述者自动裁剪改为可选。新增全局默认开关（默认关闭）控制新建叙述者是否启用裁剪，并在叙述者面板和 Agent 设置中都可调整。注意：开启可能导致提示词缓存失效、计费变贵。

## 修复

- 在设置输入框（网关 STT base URL、Cline 回调 URL 等）自动归一化 URL 协议，支持 IPv6 并能识别 Windows 路径以避免误改。
- 正确渲染反斜杠分隔的 LaTeX 公式（`\(...\)` / `\[...\]`），将其转换为美元符号语法，同时不影响代码块和行内代码。
- 为 NUG 图片缓存引入内容寻址去重和有界 LRU 引用集合，避免长对话历史中的 base64 图片在每轮请求中被完整重发。
- 通过追踪待处理的历史压缩，防止复用过期的压缩上下文，避免对同一上下文重复压缩。
